aboutSubheading: Premium electrical services for discerning homeowners
aboutText: MTR Electrical Solutions has been proudly serving Chelsea Heights and Melbourne's South Eastern suburbs for over 12 years. Our licensed and insured electricians deliver bespoke electrical solutions for residential homes — from complete rewiring and switchboard upgrades to smart home automation and luxury lighting design. We're committed to quality workmanship, punctual service, and leaving every home safer than we found it.

servicesSubheading: Comprehensive electrical solutions tailored to your home
servicesText: From simple repairs to complete home automation, MTR Electrical Solutions covers every aspect of residential electrical work. We use only premium materials and the latest techniques to ensure your home is safe, efficient, and beautifully lit.

testimonialsSubheading: Real feedback from homeowners across Melbourne's South East

testimonials.text: Matt and his team rewired our entire Chelsea Heights home during our renovation. They were professional, tidy, and kept us informed the whole way through. The lighting design they suggested has completely transformed the place. Couldn't recommend MTR more highly.
testimonials.name: Sarah Mitchell

testimonials.text: We had MTR install a full security camera system and smart doorbell at our place in Mentone. The quote was fair, the work was done on schedule, and the quality is top-notch. Matt even came back a week later to make sure everything was running perfectly.
testimonials.name: Dave Patterson

testimonials.text: As a property manager with multiple rentals in the Edithvale area, I need reliable electricians who turn up when they say they will. MTR Electrical has never let me down — they handle everything from safety switch installs to urgent callouts efficiently and affordably.
testimonials.name: Karen Ng
